notes: Rising seniors and college students apply to the same program. Contact: medicalmentorspipeline@gmail.com. Cost was not stated, so ask before applying.
name: Medical Mentors Pathway Program (M2P2)
org: Wayne State University School of Medicine, Karmanos Cancer Institute and MI-AHEC
what_you_do: Shadow doctors and other health care workers in three 2-week hospital rotations, go to weekly classes, and earn a CPR and AED certificate.
who_can_apply: Rising high school seniors (going into 12th grade) and college freshmen, sophomores and juniors.
pay_detail: Pay and cost not stated on the pages read
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed. Applicants were told by April 17, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply link on the program site. A 2-day orientation comes first. Students finish assignments and weekly classes.
